brand.name: Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition

hero.headline: Advancing Global AI Governance Through International Cooperation
hero.subtext: An international network of researchers, legal scholars, policy professionals and institutions across 55 countries, working together for safe, ethical and inclusive artificial intelligence.

about.label: ABOUT THE COALITION
about.title: A global platform for responsible AI governance
about.body: The Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition brings together researchers, academics, legal experts, policy professionals and institutional partners to strengthen international dialogue on AI governance. Convened by Atlas AI Institute, it ensures that diverse regional perspectives help shape global AI policy.

mission: To foster inclusive international dialogue, collaborative AI policy research and cross-border governance frameworks that ensure artificial intelligence develops safely, ethically and equitably for global society.
vision: A globally coordinated AI ecosystem built on shared accountability, transparency, scientific integrity and human-centered innovation.

global_reach.label: GLOBAL REACH
global_reach.title: A network that spans the world
global_reach.body: Members across five global regions contribute local insight to a shared international conversation.

membership.label: GLOBAL MEMBERSHIP
membership.title: Meet our members
membership.body: Researchers, academics, lawyers, technologists and civil society leaders from around the world.

member_countries.label: GEOGRAPHIC REPRESENTATION
member_countries.title: Member Countries
member_countries.body: Explore national chapters across 55 participating countries.

leadership.label: LEADERSHIP & GOVERNANCE
leadership.title: Founding Committee
leadership.body: Experts in AI governance, law, public policy, research partnerships, cultural governance and human rights guide the Coalition's work.

research_tracks.title: AI Governance
research_tracks.description: Institutional frameworks, oversight mechanisms and accountability structures for AI systems.

research_tracks.title: Responsible AI
research_tracks.description: Operational safety, fairness, transparency and human-centered safeguards across the AI lifecycle.

research_tracks.title: AI Ethics
research_tracks.description: Normative inquiry into rights, equity, cultural pluralism and human-centered decision-making.

research_tracks.title: AI Policy Research
research_tracks.description: Comparative, evidence-based analysis of national AI strategies and legislative readiness.

research_tracks.title: Global Regulatory Cooperation
research_tracks.description: Cross-border alignment of AI policy approaches and regulatory dialogue.

research_tracks.title: Emerging AI Technologies
research_tracks.description: Anticipating risks and opportunities from frontier technologies.

initiatives.title: Global AI Policy Dialogue Framework
initiatives.description: Structured cross-regional roundtables connecting Coalition members across Asia-Pacific, Europe, Africa, the Americas and MENA.

initiatives.title: AI Literacy & Digital Safety Initiative
initiatives.description: A collaborative track on AI literacy, synthetic media awareness and protection against technology-facilitated harms.

initiatives.title: Comparative AI Governance Observatory
initiatives.description: A tracker of national AI strategies, statutory instruments and soft-law frameworks across member countries.

contributions.label: MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS
contributions.title: Share your thoughts
contributions.body: Anyone can submit an article, policy analysis or expert thought for editorial review. Approved contributions are published for a global readership.

join.label: JOIN THE COALITION
join.title: Join a Global Movement for Responsible AI
join.body: Researchers, legal scholars, policy specialists and civil society leaders are invited to apply for membership and join the Global Member Registry.
